r Grades (Chapter3, Article 69, Chungbuk National University school rules)
  ① The grade levels, grade points, and grade point averages (GPA) for undergraduate 
courses shall be as follows. Grades of D° or above shall be counted as earned 
credits, while an F grade shall be regarded as a failed course with no credit 
earned. However, for courses such as field training, social service, and other courses 
deemed necessary by the President, grades may be recorded as P (PASS) or F (FAIL).
 ② In undergraduate programs, students may retake completed courses. Matters    
related thereto shall be determined separately by the President.
  ③ For undergraduate courses in which a make-up examination is administered, the 
grade awarded shall not exceed B°. However, an exception may be made if the 
reason for taking the make-up examination is not attributable to the student
  ④ The grade scale and grade point average for each course in the master’s and 
doctoral programs shall be as follows. Grades of C° or above shall be recognized 
as earned credits, while a grade of D shall be regarded as a non-earned credit.

r Academic Probation (Article 70, Chapter 3 of CBNU Academic Regulations)
  ① Undergraduate students whose semester GPA falls below 1.75 shall be placed on 
academic probation. However, students eligible for graduation who have fulfilled 
graduation requirements, and students who have exceeded the standard period 
of study, shall be exempt. The academic probation system shall not apply to 
students in the Colleges/Departments of Veterinary Medicine (Pre-Veterinary and 
Veterinary Medicine), Medicine (Pre-Medicine and Medicine), Pharmacy, and 
Pharmaceutical Sciences.

r What is Alien Registration?
 • Any foreign national who intends to stay in Korea for more than 90 days must 
complete Alien Registration in accordance with the Immigration Control Act.
 • After completing alien registration, a Residence Card (Alien Registration Card) will be issued.
 • Alien registration is required for essential procedures such as opening a bank 
account, obtaining a mobile phone number, and enrolling in health insurance.

r Notification of Changes to Registered Information ★
International students must report any changes to the information stated on their 
Alien Registration Card within 15 days from the date the change occurs.
※ Failure to report within the prescribed period may result in the imposition of a
  penalty (administrative fine).
1. Report of Change of Address
  • Reporting period: Within 15 days from the date of address change
  • How to report
   · Online Application: www.hikorea,go.kr > E-application > Notification of change of residence.
   · Visit : Immigration Service office, Office of District(Gu), Community Service     
Center located in new residence. 
  • Required documents: Application form, Residence card, Proof of residence
                         (e.g., valid housing contract)
  
2. Report of General Changes to Registered Information
  • Applicable Cases: When there are changes to the information stated on the
    Alien Registration Card (e.g., nationality, passport number, passport issue date
    and expiration date, name, gender, date of birth, etc.)
  • Reporting period: Within 15 days from the date of change
  • How to report
   · Online Application: www.hikorea,go.kr > E-application > Notification of change in 
registration information.
   · Visit : Jurisdictional Immigration Office
  • Required documents: Application form, Residence card, Passport
3. Change of School (Before Graduation)
  • Eligible applicants: International students who must unavoidably change
    universities while normally enrolled in a degree program
    (e.g., closure of the current university, change of desired major, etc.)
  • Reporting period: Within 15 days from the date of school change
  • Reporting location: Immigration Office having jurisdiction over the location of
                      the new university ※ Online application is not permitted
  • Applicable cases: Change of school within the same degree level
                     (e.g., University A D-2-2 è University B D-2-2)
  • Required documents: Application form, Passport, Alien Registration Card,         
   Certificate of Admission, Certificate of Enrollment (or Withdrawal) from the       
   former university, Academic Transcript from the former university,
   Consent Form for School Change from the former university,
   Application fee: KRW 60,000

r Change of Workplace
  • If the workplace is changed, the change must be reported within 15 days from the 
date of change, either by in-person visit or through online civil services.
r Measures for Violations of Part-Time Employment Permission
  • 1st Violation: Part-time employment prohibited for one year pursuant to Article 89
  • 2nd Violation: Part-time employment prohibited during the period of study pursuant to Article 89
  • 3rd Violation: Revocation of student status pursuant to Article 89
    ※ In the construction industry, a departure order will be issued immediately
      regardless of the number of violations.
r Employment without Permission
  • Both the international student and the employer are subject to up to three years 
of imprisonment or a fine of up to KRW 20 million for violation of Article 20.
r Activities Exempt from Part-Time Employment Permission (Examples)
  • Temporary activities that do not infringe upon the essential nature of the student 
status, such as receiving honoraria, prizes, or compensation incidental to daily life, 
are exempt from permission.
  • Examples
   · Receiving allowances for internships or research projects conducted on campus for 
academic credit
   · Participating as teaching assistants (including class assistants), library assistants, or other 
work-study scholarship positions within the university
   · Receiving temporary compensation for non-professional household or office assistance
   · Receiving compensation for non-professional activities such as consulting, appraisal, event
     participation, or temporary (one-time, non-continuous) appearances in films or broadcasts,
     and other similar activities

Q1. What is the Advisor Program?
A. The Advisor Program is a mentoring program in which senior international 
students (Advisors) at Chungbuk National University help new international 
freshmen adapt to campus life and living in Korea. The program aims to 
support freshmen in settling into university life smoothly.
Q2. What kind of support do Advisors provide?
A. Advisors provide guidance on:
  § Campus tours and basic university facilities
  § How to use academic systems (GAESINNURI system, eCampus, etc.)
  § Alien registration procedures
  § Health insurance and basic administrative procedures
  § Daily life information such as transportation and campus life
   ※ Official academic, visa, or legal matters are handled by the relevant offices.
Q3. What is the activity period and time commitment?
A. The program runs from March to July 2026, and the total activity time is 
approximately 50–100 hours. The schedule may vary depending on the semester.
Q4. How are Advisors matched with freshmen?
A. One Advisor is matched with approximately eight freshmen, considering 
nationality, department, and language background.
Q5. How and when can I meet my Advisor?
A. You can meet your Advisor during the New Student Orientation.
   If you cannot attend the orientation, your Advisor will contact you by email,
   so please check your email regularly and respond actively.
Q6. Are there any additional notes?
A. Advisors are required to submit an activity report to the International Student 
Support Center, so photos may be taken during activities. If you do not wish 
to participate in the program, please inform your Advisor politely. For 
questions that are difficult to ask your Advisor, please contact the 
International Student Support Center.

r 성적(충북대학교 학칙 3장 제69조)
  ① 학사과정의 교과목별 성적 등급과 평점 평균은 다음과 같이 하되, D°급 이상을 취득 
   학점으로 하고 F급은 미취득 학점으로 한다. 다만, 현장실습, 사회봉사 및 그 밖의 총장이
   필요하다고 인정하는 교과목의 경우에서 P(PASS) 또는 F(FAIL)로 성적을 부여할 수 있다.
  ② 학사과정에서는 이수한 교과목을 재이수 할 수 있으며, 이에 관한 사항은 총장이 따로 정한다.  
  ③ 학사과정에서 추가시험을 실시한 교과목 성적은 B°이하로 한다. 다만, 추가시험 응시사유가
     학생의 책임이 아닌 경우에는 예외로 한다.
  ④ 석·박사과정의 교과목별 성적 등급과 평점 평균은 다음과 같이 하되, C°급 이상을 취득학점으로 
하고, D는 미취득 학점으로 한다. 다만, 전문대학원의 성적평가에 대한 사항은 해당      
대학원장이 따로 정한다.
  ⑤ 학사과정은 총 수업시간의 4분의 3이상, 석·박사과정은 총 수업시간의 3분의 2이상을 출석
     하지 않은 때에는 그 교과목의 성적 등급은 학사과정은 F, 석·박사과정은 D로 하고, 전체 
     평점평균에 포함되며 성적표에 모두 기재된다.
  ⑥ 석·박사과정에서는 동일 학위과정에서 이미 이수한 교과목을 재이수할 수 있으며, 이미 취득한
     성적은 무효로 하고, 재이수한 성적과 학점을 인정한다.

Q1. Advisor 프로그램이란 무엇인가요?
A. Advisor 프로그램은 충북대학교에서 수학 중인 선배 외국인 유학생(Advisor)이 
외국인 신입생의 대학생활 및 한국 생활 적응을 돕는 멘토링 프로그램입니다.
   신입생들이 낯선 환경에 빠르게 적응하고 안정적인 유학생활을 할 수 있도록 실질적인 
도움을 제공합니다.
Q2. Advisor는 어떤 도움을 제공하나요?
A. Advisor는 다음과 같은 사항을 지원합니다. 
  § 학교 및 캠퍼스 투어 안내
  § 학사시스템(개신누리, eCampus 등) 사용 방법 안내
  § 외국인 등록(체류) 신청 절차 안내
  § 보험 가입 및 기본 행정 절차 안내
  § 기숙사, 교통, 생활 전반에 관한 기본 정보 제공
   ※ 단, 법률·비자·학사 결정 사항 등은 담당 부서로 안내합니다.
Q3. Advisor 활동 기간과 시간은 어떻게 되나요?
A. 활동 기간은 2026년 3월부터 2026년 7월까지이며, Advisor의 전체 활동 시간은 
총 50~100시간 내외입니다. 세부 일정은 학기 운영에 따라 조정될 수 있습니다.
Q4. Advisor와 신입생은 어떻게 매칭되나요?
A. Advisor 1명당 신입생 약 8명 내외로 매칭됩니다. 국적, 학과, 언어 등을 종합적으로 
고려하여 매칭합니다.
Q5. Advisor는 언제, 어떻게 만날 수 있나요?
A. 신입생 오리엔테이션 기간 중 직접 만날 수 있습니다. 오리엔테이션에 참석하지 
못한 경우, 담당 Advisor가 이메일로 개별 연락할 예정이므로 이메일을 반드시 
확인해 주시고 적극적으로 소통해 주시기 바랍니다.
Q6. 기타 유의사항은 무엇인가요?
A. Advisor는 활동 종료 후 유학생지원센터에 활동보고서를 제출해야 하므로,
   활동 중 신입생과 함께 사진 촬영이 필요할 수 있습니다.
   ADVISOR 프로그램 참여를 원하지 않을 경우, Advisor에게 정중히 의사를 전달해  
   주시기 바랍니다. Advisor에게 문의하기 어려운 사항은 *유학생 담당자(유학생지  
   원센터)*에 문의해 주시기 바랍니다.

section_title: 外国留学生新生Advisor（导师）项目
text:
Q1. 什么是ADVISOR 项目？
A. Advisor 项目是由在忠北大学就读的高年级外国留学生（Advisor），
为外国新生提供大学生活及韩国生活适应指导的导师制度项目。
该项目旨在帮助新生顺利适应校园生活。
Q2. Advisor 会提供哪些帮助？
A. Advisor 将协助新生了解以下内容：
§ 校园及主要设施介绍
§ 学校学务系统（GAESINNURI、eCampus 等）使用方法
§ 外国人登录（居留）申请流程
§ 保险及基本行政手续说明
§ 交通、生活等日常信息
※ 学业、签证及法律相关事项将由相关部门负责。
Q3. Advisor 项目的活动时间是多久？
A. 活动期间为2026年3月至2026年7月，总活动时间约为50–100小时（具体安排可能
根据学期调整）。
Q4. Advisor 与新生如何进行匹配？
A. 一名Advisor 通常负责约8名新生，并综合考虑国籍、专业及语言等因素进行匹配。
Q5. 什么时候、如何与Advisor 见面？
A. 新生可在**新生入学说明会（Orientation）**期间与Advisor 见面。
如未能参加说明会，Advisor 将通过电子邮件与您联系，请务必确认并及时回复邮件。
Q6. 还有其他需要注意的事项吗？
A. Advisor 在活动结束后需向留学生支援中心提交活动报告，因此活动中可能需要拍照，
请理解。如不希望参加本项目，请礼貌地告知Advisor。
如有不便向Advisor 咨询的问题，请直接联系留学生负责人/留学生支援中心。
